ei.title: Segmenting vs. Integrating Work and Life
ei.subject: 올림포스전국연합고1_2026

fullPassage: Boundaries between work and home are blurring as portable digital technology makes it increasingly possible to work anywhere, anytime. Individuals differ in how they like to manage their time to meet work and outside responsibilities. Some people prefer to separate or segment roles so that boundary crossings are minimized. For example, these people might keep separate email accounts for work and family and try to conduct work at the workplace and take care of family matters only during breaks and non-work time. We've even noticed more of these "segmenters" carrying two phones ― one for work and one for personal use. Flexible schedules work well for these individuals because they enable greater distinction between time at work and time in other roles. Other individuals prefer integrating work and family roles all day long. This might entail constantly trading text messages with children from the office, or monitoring emails at home and on vacation, rather than returning to work to find hundreds of messages in their inbox.

questions.passage: Boundaries between work and home are blurring as portable digital technology makes it increasingly possible to work anywhere, anytime. Individuals differ in how they like to manage their time to meet work and outside responsibilities. Some people prefer to separate or segment roles so that <u>boundary crossings</u> are minimized. For example, these people might keep separate email accounts for work and family and try to conduct work at the workplace and take care of family matters only during breaks and non-work time. We've even noticed more of these "segmenters" carrying two phones ― one for work and one for personal use. Flexible schedules work well for these individuals because they enable greater distinction between time at work and time in other roles. Other individuals prefer integrating work and family roles all day long. This might entail constantly trading text messages with children from the office, or monitoring emails at home and on vacation, rather than returning to work to find hundreds of messages in their inbox.
questions.stem: 위 글의 밑줄 친 boundary crossings이 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ② boundary crossings = 일과 가정이라는 서로 다른 영역을 넘나드는 일
det.analysis:
❌ ① 이직: 회사를 옮기는 것이 아니라 역할 영역을 넘나드는 것
✅ ② 일과 가정 영역을 넘나드는 일: 'separate or segment roles so that boundary crossings are minimized'에서 boundary crossings는 일·가정 경계를 넘나드는 일을 뜻하며, 분리형은 이를 최소화하려 함 ←정답
❌ ③ 해외 출장: 실제 국경이 아닌 역할 간 경계를 의미
❌ ④ 기술 도입: boundary crossings와 무관
det.tip: boundary crossings = 일·가정 경계를 넘나드는 일(역할 전환)
